title: Compliance Manual — Re-dating Verification Buffer Under Payment Arrangements
content:
Returned payments made outside any payment plan on a placed account set a re-dating verification buffer when an installment of a plan under Payment Arrangements on that account is re-dated.

## Clause

The re-dating verification buffer follows the payments on the placed account that were not made under a payment plan and were returned in the last twelve months. These are read from the money history of the placed account under Placed Consumer Accounts: the returned payment entries of that account that carry no payment plan reference.

(a) An account with at least one such returned payment whose most recent such return was for account closed or stop payment adds a re-dating verification buffer of 2 days.

(b) An account with at least one such returned payment whose most recent such return was for NSF, unauthorized debit or card chargeback adds a re-dating verification buffer of 4 days.

(c) An account with no such returned payment adds a re-dating verification buffer of 0 days.

Periods of twelve months are counted in whole months back from the handling date. Returned installment payments booked under a plan are not "such" payments.

## Condition table

| Returned payments outside any plan on the placed account, last 12 months | Reason of the most recent such return | Buffer |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | Account closed or stop payment | 2 days |
| One or more | NSF, unauthorized debit or card chargeback | 4 days |
| None | — | 0 days |

## Illustrations (hypothetical histories)

- The account's money history shows two returned direct payments in the last twelve months, the earlier for NSF and the later for stop payment: the most recent is a stop payment, so the buffer is 2 days.
- The only returned payment outside a plan in the last twelve months was a card chargeback: 4 days.
- The only returned payments on the account were installment payments under a plan, or the last returned direct payment is more than twelve whole months old: 0 days.
